The learned counsel for the Petitioner clarified that the claim invoked in Petition No. 126/MP/2024 is against the Respondent WRLDC and no charges have been claimed against GUVNL. **12.** The counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the instant Petition was heard along with Petition Nos..13/MP/2024 and 39/MP/2024, as all of them primarily sought similar relief to allow the scheduling of full capacity of power from the Petitioners’ plant at Raghanesda Ultra Mega Solar Park. While Petition Nos. 13/MP/2024 and 39/MP/2024 have already been reserved for order by the Commission; the present matter has been further listed as the Petitioner herein has also prayed for direction against WRLDC to compensate the Petitioner for the monetary loss incurred by it on account of unlawful instructions issued by WRLDC. However, the Petitioner is no longer pressing for the said relief. **16.** The Respondent, WRLDC, confirmed that WRLDC has issued a provisional approval to the Petitioner for charging and trial run of the above equipment. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, the Commission reserved the matter for order. **20.** We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and the Respondents, and also the documents placed on the record. Therefore, based on the above, the following issues arise for our consideration: **27.** We have perused the undertaking given by the Petitioner dated 06.08.2021 covered under the present Petition as under: **32.** We note that despite giving a clear undertaking specifying the exact reactive power compensation which shall be installed by them in four-five months from placement of Order, various communications from WRLDC to meet compliances, the Petitioner failed to install reactive power device as committed as late as end of calendar year 2024beginning of calendar year 2025 which displays a lack of sincerity and seriousness on part of the Petitioner to install reactive power devices. We disagree with the Petitioner’s contention that they kept waiting for WRLDC confirmation of their reports. Once they gave an undertaking in 2021 to install reactive devices, based on which they were allowed to commission their project, the Petitioner cannot take shelter under the Working Group report formation. Furthermore, the report provided confirmation from WRLDC regarding their non-compliance. We express our displeasure at the Petitioner’s failure to comply with various communications from WRLDC. The Petitioner should have installed the devices as committed vide their undertaking. The Petitioner is directed to follow the directions of WRLDC under the Act and Regulations in letter and spirit, and meet all compliances with all the Standards and Regulations.
